description: Inspect this inbox's blocked senders. Only the human can edit them in Account > Receiving rules. Matching mail does not arrive; messages already received are unaffected.
name: get_receiving_policy

addresses.description: Exact blocked From addresses. Local-part case matters; domain case does not. Plus tags and dots remain distinct. Mail whose From matches either list does not arrive.

domains.description: Exact blocked ASCII From domains, lowercased. Subdomains are not included unless listed separately.

enabled.description: False pauses blocking and keeps saved lists. Empty lists block nothing even when enabled.

title: Get receiving rules
